name: dsh-deepseek-keypool
description: DSH Provider 分档故障转移 —— 模型请求以额度/凭据/过载/限流等可切换失败结束时，按配置表档位顺序切换 harness 路由（provider）；凭据类失败先在条目内轮换 key（改写该路由的 apiKeyEnv 引用名，路由与模型不变），并按每日重置时刻恢复默认 key。设置页可查看并编辑每个条目的 key 引用（凭据引用名）与状态（在用/可用/失效[时间·错误]/未配置），并可做会话级测试切换（/failover-test 指令或按钮）。不持有也不读写任何凭据值。

metadata.author: wang
metadata.changelog: 3.6.1: content_filter（上游内容安全拦截）纳入切换——failurePatterns 增加 content_filter / content filter，生效码折算为 CONTENT_FILTER；retryPolicies.CONTENT_FILTER.attempts=0（不原地重试，直接换来源）；cooldownMsFor 对 CONTENT_FILTER 返回 0（拦截是请求内容问题，不冻结路由，cooldownByCode.CONTENT_FILTER 仍可覆盖）；failureReasons 新增 CONTENT_FILTERED 可读原因；probe/smoke-config.mjs 新增 7 条断言。 3.6.0: 设置页多 key 卡片补上与 Host 同口径的保存前校验——引用名形状（^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$，与 index.js KEY_REF_PATTERN 逐字一致）、条目内重复、跨条目重复都在行内标红并给中文原因，不再出现「行先加上、点保存才被英文 400 打回」；主保存按钮一并提交待保存的 keysByEntry（此前只提交通用字段，key 草稿点了像没生效）；Host 的英文 key 校验错误翻成可操作中文；未配置徽标补全含义（缺的是值，引用名没问题）且空行不再显示未保存徽标；client.js 导出 __test 供离线单测；新增 probe/smoke-keys.mjs（校验逻辑单测，含两半正则一致性断言）与 probe/client-panel.mjs（设置面板真实渲染回归）。 3.5.0: settings panel gains two host-catalog dropdowns — ranking model (provider+model, user-layer rankingModel override, null clears it) and default model (provider+model, saved through the host agentDefaultModel service); new read-only endpoint GET /provider-failover/catalog enumerates host providers/models with per-provider error tolerance; POST /provider-failover/config accepts rankingModel/defaultModel with live catalog validation (unknown route -> 400, missing service -> 503); status/editable snapshot now expose rankingModel/defaultModel/defaultModelAvailable/defaultModelError; README documents the new fields; .gitignore now excludes manual *.bak-* copies. 3.4.0: load credential-free local route-config.json from DSH_HOME/plugins/provider-failover at startup; preserve existing settings.json and profile configuration. 3.3.0: transport failures now fail over to the next provider — 'websocket closed' joins the message-pattern fallback and TRANSPORT becomes a terminal code, so an un-normalized 'WebSocket closed 1000' (host maps it to generic PI_AI_ERROR) still switches (probe display aligned to 传输中断). policy (content/safety) failures now default to policyMode 'same' — keep the current provider/model and retry in-place within the same (turn, step) (bounded by maxPolicyRetriesPerStep), instead of switching provider; 'switch'/'off' restore the old policyFailover semantics. Prompt rewrite on retry is impossible (frozen loop requests + request-reconstruction invariant), documented in README. 3.2.4: adapt to dsh 0.2 (settings moved to the plugin-owned settings.json; active key ref now read via SettingsForms.describe), probe drives the file scope in an isolated DSH_HOME, and the isSwitchable policy comment matches the default policyFailover: true behavior.
